en.title: Broadcast protocol test
en.body:
Hello! This is a test for the upcoming 0.6.4 update, i'm just testing the broadcasting feature (already in 0.6.3 but never used), if you're reading this, well you're the first ones to know 0.6.4 will be out soon.
Not many tests to run after this one.

Stay tuned, have fun.
